notes: Single 'Bez.' column of letters A-U drives both Gelbe Tonne and Blaue Papiertonne on the same day (one Bezirk = one pickup day for both bins); the street-to-Bezirk lookup ('Straßenverzeichnis 2026') isn't in this PDF, so district A was picked as the alphabetically-first letter per protocol. Each of the four labelled months has exactly one Bezirk-A day. The two Schadstoffmobil dates per month (SR=Rathausplatz, SF=Kirchplatz Fedderwardergroden) run on a citywide schedule independent of the Bezirk letters, so both are listed even though they aren't specifically tied to district A.
